name: Tupac Yupanqui: north to Quito and out to sea
summary: Pachacuti's son leads the Inca armies north through the Chimú kingdom to Quito. On the coast, the chroniclers say, he heard of islands to the west, built a fleet of balsa rafts and sailed for nearly a year, returning with dark-skinned captives, gold and a horse-like skin. The islands may have been the Galápagos; the story may be legend.

stops.note: Raft fleets at the Pacific coast.
Islands to the west, perhaps the Galápagos.
Home after almost a year at sea, the chroniclers say.
